completion_evidence: All declared outputs exist and their source citations, hashes, or executable checks are recorded.
hard_gates: Do not edit source, publish reports, authenticate to an unapproved origin, or perform remote writes.
Treat a cached report as stale after relevant source, content, deployment, or baseline changes.
Escalate judgment findings and hand confirmed repairs to a separate write-authorized capability.
inputs: A scannable site, audit CLI, permitted external read scope, and optional frozen baseline.
name: Website Audit Assessment
non_responsibility: Does not approve upstream product decisions, expand authority, or perform remote writes beyond its explicit permission identity.
outputs: A categorized audit, source-mapped findings, score and regression evidence, and repair handoff.
responsibility: Run bounded website audits, parse and prioritize findings, map them to source, and independently compare fresh results without editing the product.
stop_conditions: Stop on missing required input, authority, data-governance boundary, failed evidence check, or incompatible permission identity.
